scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && uv run tests/e2e/test_split.py
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:source: mkdir -p artifacts && rm -f artifacts/split_companion-$npm_package_version-source.zip && zip -qr artifacts/split_companion-$npm_package_version-source.zip src static scripts tests package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md -x '*.DS_Store' '*__pycache__*'
